description:
Open documentation issues in other epics overlap the overhaul's documentation contract. Each one receives an explicit disposition, so no surviving requirement is lost and no obsolete deliverable stays open.

## Background

The candidate set changes as other work lands. The starting candidates and their overlap analysis are in `dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` (§3.13), which also notes that one comment-trim candidate blocks a performance epic. Two dispositions apply: a requirement that overlaps overhaul scope is preserved in an overhaul work item and the original issue is rejected as subsumed; an item-level API documentation fix stays where it is and gains the filter label.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The candidate set is derived from the live tracker when this work starts, and every open documentation issue outside the overhaul epic appears in a linked disposition record with its disposition and a one-line reason.
- [hard] REQ-02: An issue whose requirement overlaps the source-comment sweep, the Rustdoc example policy, or the permanent-page rewrite has that requirement present in the success criteria of a named overhaul work item before the issue is rejected with `resolution:obsolete` and a comment naming that work item.
- [hard] REQ-03: An item-level API documentation fix stays in its own epic with its existing dependency edges and carries the `epic:documentation-overhaul` filter label.
- [hard] REQ-04: No rejection leaves a dependent issue blocked on an obligation that no open issue carries.
- [hard] REQ-05: The epic's linked planning brief records each disposition in its inherited-issue section.
title: Reconcile open docs-remediation issues outside the overhaul
